name: roadmap-columns
title: Roadmap columns
description: A public roadmap in Now, Next and Later columns: each item with a status in words and a short why, and no dates you cannot keep.
docs: Pass three or four columns. A column with the id now, next, later or shipped also gets that phase's mark in its heading; any other id can pass phase. A card with an href is one stretched link and a card without one stays plain. Write statuses in words (In progress, Designing, Exploring) and keep dates out: that is the point. Each column is a labelled list with its count in the heading, and the cards of every lane start on one line from 768px. shippedHref adds a link to your changelog under the board, and note replaces the built-in Plans change footnote (pass null to leave it out). Pass linkAs={Link} to route the card links.
